why: The must_catch item says line 3 ("README.md has a section for padLeft") should FAIL. The request wants the README's function list to be complete, but slugify is exported in index.js and never documented in README.md, so a build that only adds a padLeft section would still leave the list incomplete. The output marks line 3 "PASS" with the boilerplate evidence "This line looks fine and is clear." It never mentions slugify, and its wrong_build is "None found; the issue looks complete."
